insight: Open-core: the Apache-2.0 core is fully OSI-licensed, while only the optional 'pro' module ships under the fair-source FSL 1.1 license.
name: Dyad
tagline: Local, open-source AI app builder that runs on your machine with your own API keys.
description: Dyad is a desktop AI app builder — like Lovable, v0, or Bolt, but running locally on your own machine. You describe an app and it scaffolds full-stack web projects, bringing your own keys across providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, LM Studio), with built-in Supabase, GitHub, and Vercel integration plus security scanning.

modelSupport.notes: Bring your own API keys across cloud and local providers; an optional Dyad Pro plan sells managed credits.

edge: Runs the whole app-builder locally with your own API keys, so unlike cloud tools like Lovable or v0 your code and data never leave your machine.
cons: Needs your own model keys or credits
